snippet.title: Warship Battle Commander
snippet.description:
Android :
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.warshipking

iOS :
https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1241244638?mt=8

Warship Battle Commander is a tactical board game based on naval combat.

Locate enemy vessels and strike them before they do.
Enjoy the most advanced turn based warship battle! 

[Feature]
- Tons of maps & stages
- Thrilling boss stages 
- Use destructive battle enforcement items
- Challenge the world rankers’ battle records.
- Multiplayer Mode without networks or Wifi (Max 4 player battle) 
- Versus mode against warship commanders from all around the world
- Leaderboard, Achievement, Friend invitation supported
- 16 language supported
- Tablet devices supported 

Homepage :
https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=4864673505117639552

Facebook : 
https://www.facebook.com/mobirixplayen
